title: Empty the Audio Recorder trash, then clear the MiXplorer recycle bin
instruction: Permanently delete all discarded items by emptying the Trash folder in the Audio Recorder app, then open the Mixplorer app and clear its recycle bin as well.

steps.thought: This is the most immediate and often the quickest way to find an app if it's simply organized on a different screen. If that doesn't yield results, my next thought would be to access the app drawer, which provides a comprehensive list of all installed applications.

The user wants to empty the Trash folder in the Audio Recorder app and clear the recycle bin in the Mixplorer app.
I swiped left on the home screen, but I don't see Audio Recorder or Mixplorer here either.
I should open the app drawer to find them.
I will swipe up from the bottom of the screen to open the app drawer.

I see the Audio Recorder app in the app drawer.
I will click on it to open it.

The Audio Recorder app is open.
I need to find the Trash folder.
There's a menu icon (three dots) in the top right corner, and a list icon in the bottom right corner.
The list icon usually represents recordings. Let's check the list icon first.

This is the Records list. I don't see a Trash folder here.
Let's go back to the main screen and check the settings or the three dots menu.
I'll click the back arrow in the top left corner.

Now I'm back on the main screen.
Let's check the settings icon in the bottom left corner.

Ah, here is the Trash option in the Settings menu.
I will click on "Trash".

The Trash folder is already empty.
Now I need to open the Mixplorer app and clear its recycle bin.
I will press the Home button to go back to the desktop.

I am back on the home screen.
I need to open the app drawer again to find Mixplorer.
I will swipe up from the bottom.

I am in the app drawer. I need to find Mixplorer.
It's not visible on this screen. I will scroll down.

I see the Mixplorer app (labeled "MiX").
I will click on it to open it.

Mixplorer is open. I need to find its recycle bin and clear it.
I see a hamburger menu icon in the top left corner. Let's click that to see if the recycle bin is there.

I see "Recycle bin" at the bottom of the menu.
I will click on it.

The recycle bin in Mixplorer is also empty ("No item").
I have completed both tasks: checked/emptied the Trash in Audio Recorder and checked/cleared the recycle bin in Mixplorer.
I can now terminate the task.
